description:
Serve the domain-derived short id with each issue the API returns, so clients never truncate ids themselves.

## Background

`get_issue` and `list_issues` return `Json<Issue>` and `Json<Vec<Issue>>` directly (`crates/server/src/routes.rs:82-105`), and the graph DTO `GraphNode` holds `id: String` (`routes.rs:132-133`). The issue record's JSON shape is a storage contract, so a short id belongs in the response, not the record. The web UI currently truncates ids itself.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each issue in the issue and issue-list responses carries a `short_id` equal to `IssueId::short_id()` of its id, and its dependency entries carry their short ids.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each graph node carries the short id of its issue.
- [hard] REQ-03: Stored issue records are unchanged, and server tests assert the short id as the domain derivation of the id.
title: Server issue responses carry the domain short id
